# Suburban Essex Dental

> > Top-rated dental practice in West Orange, NJ offering comprehensive general, restorative, cosmetic, and surgical dental services with advanced technology and a patient-centered approach.

Suburban Essex Dental is a leading dental practice in Essex County, New Jersey, headed by Dr. Paul R. Feldman, D.M.D. The practice specializes in comprehensive dental care ranging from routine cleanings to complex restorative and surgical procedures, utilizing advanced technologies like laser dentistry and 3D imaging.
